VERDANT AIRPORT MAP REFORMULATION
So I have this map for a while. But this weeks I have been looking throught this Forum and saw that many people are posting Abandoned Airport maps, So I remembered of mine ande I decided to post it here for you guys. Hope you enjoy it.
If You will use it in your server please send me some pics and the IP Adress in my PM, I will really love it. And I also hope that it will help you.
If I will have time, possibly I will be releasing more maps.
